verdict: One real product bug (cm size chart uses the wrong conversion factor) and one test bug; the other two failures point to an unstable local server at localhost:3100.

failures.test: Product extras › the size chart switches between inches and centimetres
failures.summary: Every CM value in the size chart is about 3.5% too low, consistent with multiplying by 2.45 instead of 2.54.
failures.evidence: Expected "69.9", received "M95.667.420.8"; snapshot row "M 95.6 67.4 20.8" vs inch row "M 39 27.5 8.5" (27.5×2.45=67.4, 39×2.45=95.6, 8.5×2.45=20.8). This exceeds the heading's own "Expected Deviation < 3%".
failures.next_step: Fix the inch-to-cm conversion constant in the size chart component (2.45 should be 2.54), then rerun this test.

failures.test: Product info › Add to Cart updates the header basket badge
failures.summary: Line 52 asserts that the Add to Cart button reads "2", but the count belongs to the header basket badge, and that badge did update correctly.
failures.evidence: locator('.product-info__add') resolved to "Added", then "Add to Cart"; snapshot shows button "Basket, 2 items".
failures.next_step: Delete line 52 or point it at the basket badge, and wait for "Added" right after addToCart, since the button reverts to "Add to Cart".

failures.test: Product info › shows the product name and price
failures.summary: The local server at localhost:3100 refused connections in beforeEach on both attempts, while other tests in the same run reached it.
failures.evidence: page.goto: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED at http://localhost:3100/ (167ms, page chrome-error://chromewebdata/)
failures.next_step: Check the dev/webServer logs for restarts or crashes during the run, and make sure the Playwright webServer config waits for the port to be ready and keeps the server up.

failures.test: Product extras › opening an accordion item reveals its content
failures.summary: The page took longer than 30s to reach the load event on the first attempt and passed on retry; no product defect is visible.
failures.evidence: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded; nav status 200, snapshot shows "Delivery Date: Calculating delivery date".
failures.next_step: Check whether the delivery-date request or another resource stalls the load event on the local server; if so, switch gotoProduct to waitUntil 'domcontentloaded'.
